Title: Vihaan's Little Adventure

Cast

1. Vihaan - 9 years, son
Look: yellow T-shirt, blue shorts
2. Hema - 39 years, mother
Look: pink kurta, a long plait
3. Naira - 9 years, daughter
Look: yellow frock, two plaits
4. Sharda - 74 years, grandmother
Look: white saree, glasses
5. Siya - 11 years, friend
Look: pink T-shirt, ponytail

Places

1. The courtyard - a brick floor, a tulsi plant

Scene 1: The courtyard - Day

[Vihaan stands in the courtyard. Hema, Sharda and Siya stand near him.]

Sharda: "Today feels like a good day."

[Vihaan hugs Mother tightly.]

Vihaan (surprised): "How beautiful!"

[Vihaan shakes his head.]

Vihaan (laughing): "Hmm, I see."

[A light drizzle begins.]

Siya: "I knew it!"

[Vihaan milks the cow.]

Hema: "Vihaan, look at this."

[A cat walks along the wall.]

Siya (laughing): "Really?"

[Vihaan pats his horse.]

Vihaan: "I really enjoyed today."
